summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(ref == uri for uri in self.__uris.values()), using node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The _ipython_key_completions_ hook now returns dir(self.uri), as the spec asks; this lists string methods rather than term names, which is a side effect worth reviewing. Tests added to NamespacePrefixTest cover prefix positive/negative/self, RDFS positive/negative/plain-string/Literal, and RDF rdf:type positive plus rdf:_1 negative. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. No commit was made.
